_hinweis: Texts on the topic of the league table. tabellenspitze: press headline. abstiegszone: a board member writes to the manager (formal). Placeholders: {verein}, {platz}, {reporter}, {medium}, {vorstand}.

standard: {verein} lead the table. {reporter} ({medium}): “Anyone who's on top after this many matchdays is there on merit. From now on every opponent will be especially motivated.”
League leaders: {verein} have established themselves at the top. {reporter} ({medium}) asks how the team copes with everyone else now chasing them.
